summary: The quaff command reaches POT_FULL_HEALING, but JS refuses the effect before it runs. C potion.c peffect_full_healing() prints “You feel completely healed.”, heals up to 400 HP with a blessing-sensitive maximum-HP increase, then applies its remaining cure, attribute, level, and leg-wound effects.

source.branch: When peffects() selects POT_FULL_HEALING, peffect_full_healing() always reports complete healing and calls healup(400, 4 + 4*bcsign(otmp), !otmp->cursed, TRUE). Blessed potions restore one lost level when u.ulevel is below u.ulevelmax; all potions clear hallucination and exercise Strength then Constitution; blessed potions heal leg wounds even while riding, while uncursed potions do so only when not riding. healup() receives curesick=true for every non-cursed potion and itself delegates sickness clearing to make_sick().
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:1333-1425 peffects() dispatches POT_FULL_HEALING at 1401-1403 to peffect_full_healing(); js/potion.js:1715-1800 mirrors the dispatch but throws UnsupportedQuaffError at the POT_FULL_HEALING case instead of calling the effect.

nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1809-1810 maps q to dodrink(); potion.c:526-625 sends the selected potion through dodrink(), dopotion(), and peffects(). The JS production path is js/extcmdlist_data.js:102 quaff -> js/cmd.js runQuaffCommand() -> js/potion.js dodrink() -> dopotion() -> peffects().

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:1144-1162 is the complete peffect_full_healing() source function; it emits the heal message, calls healup(), optionally restores one lost level for a blessed potion, clears hallucination, exercises A_STR then A_CON, and conditionally heals wounded legs. nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:1401-1403 is the POT_FULL_HEALING caller. js/potion.js:1784-1785 currently stops at UnsupportedQuaffError instead of implementing this function, so the source scope is the whole peffect_full_healing() function in potion.c.

nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1809-1810 maps q to dodrink(); nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:526-625 runs dodrink() -> dopotion() -> peffects(). JS wiring is js/extcmdlist_data.js:102 -> js/cmd.js:3394-3395 -> js/potion.js:1875-1980 -> js/potion.js:1834-1839 -> js/potion.js:1715-1785. The failure is in the production dispatch, not an unreachable helper.

The full-healing source call makes helper completion part of the source contract: potion.c:1147 passes curesick=true for the recorded uncursed potion; potion.c healup() at 1428-1458 calls make_sick(0, NULL, TRUE, SICK_ALL) at 1452-1455. js/potion.js healup() at 2772-2799 currently has the required HP and blindness/deafness path but records note_unported("potion.c make_sick") when curesick is true. Keep potion.c healup and potion.c make_sick as explicit source dependencies; do not treat a locally correct healup call as complete sickness behavior.

The saved C recording challenges/cases/v16/wizard-quaffs-full-healing-after-acid-damage.session.json has 83 steps. At step 81 the wizard chooses the potion; step 82 shows “You feel completely healed.” and HP 16(16), after acid damage left HP 8(12) at step 78. .cache/v16-investigations/10.json and challenges/evaluations/20261001125731-v16.json record a stop on step 82, with 82/83 screens and cursors matched and 2789/2809 RNG calls matched. The saved case shows the missing effect and its visible outcome without making its seed, inputs, or inventory a special case.

A search for potion.c, peffect_full_healing, healup, and make_sick in nethack-c/patches returned no matches. The recorder-specific behavior for this case is therefore the upstream potion.c behavior cited above; no patch-specific branch changes the effect.
